question: Can the 2026 NFRDI non-indigenous fish risk assessment or its ongoing inland-lake program supply current Bicol species-presence rows?

sourcesReviewed.citation: Magistrado, M. L., Merilles, M. L. D., Muyot, M. C., and Mutia, M. T. (2026). Risk Assessment of Introduced Species in Five Lakes in the Philippines. The Philippine Journal of Fisheries, 33(1), 153-170. DOI: 10.31398/tpjf/33.1.2025A0003.
sourcesReviewed.access: Official NFRDI repository metadata and abstract reviewed. Direct PDF retrieval timed out; official indexed article text was searched for its risk-assessment methods, Lake Buhi section, and Lake Buhi table. Full paper not downloaded or retained.

sourcesReviewed.citation: National Fisheries Research and Development Institute. FY 2024 Annual Report, inland-lake stock assessment project listing.
sourcesReviewed.access: Official NFRDI annual-report text was reviewed through indexed excerpts for the inland-lake project entry and its stated duration. This is a program listing, not a fish checklist or dataset.

riskAssessment.framework: Aquatic Species Invasiveness Screening Kit (AS-ISK), assessed in a multi-stakeholder workshop; the paper reports Basic Risk Assessment and a climate-change component.
riskAssessment.scope: The source separates extant and horizon categories. It defines horizon species as not recorded within that risk assessment during its study period but considered likely to enter or establish in the future.
riskAssessment.buhiInterpretation: A risk classification, stakeholder score, or horizon listing is not an independently sampled species occurrence record. Do not infer a species is currently present in Lake Buhi from a horizon category or the article's risk result.
notSupported: A complete native or introduced fish checklist for Lake Buhi, Bicol, Luzon, or the Philippines.
Station-level occurrence, abundance, catchability, natural diet, or current fishing availability.
A fish safety, harvest legality, or protected-area rule.
Species presence inferred from a horizon risk-screen category.

programContext.annualReportEntry: The FY 2024 annual report lists an inland-lakes stock-assessment project with Lake Buhi, Lake Bato, and Naujan Lake in its scope and gives a January 2023-December 2028 duration.
programContext.interpretationLimit: This is a project/program listing, not evidence that every lake has a completed dataset or that the listed locations metadata cleanly maps the work to all named lakes. It helps explain why later primary outputs may still be pending; it does not establish a release date.

qualityAndRights.evidenceLevel: Official NFRDI risk-assessment article metadata and indexed text plus an official program-listing excerpt. The paper PDF did not successfully retrieve in the bounded web review.
qualityAndRights.reuseStatus: No item-specific license or permission was verified. Do not reproduce the article's species tables or risk scores in the app. No publication approval is granted.
qualityAndRights.handling: Research-only source screen. No full paper, table or assessment data retained.

disposition.reason: This work evaluates invasion risk, not a comprehensive species inventory; horizon classification explicitly does not mean observed presence. Full technical access and item-specific reuse terms remain unresolved.

nextAction: Continue the Bicol inventory from source-level river, lake, reservoir and coastal surveys. In parallel, seek a public primary species-composition checklist or technical-report release for the ongoing NFRDI inland-lake project; do not wait for it to process other source leads.

sources.supports: Official NFRDI repository citation, author/year, journal collection, abstract, five-lake scope, AS-ISK method, and definition of horizon species.
Official Philippine Journal of Fisheries article metadata and indexed article text for the Lake Buhi risk-screen context; the direct page was not retrievable in this review.
Official full-text PDF URL for future verification; direct retrieval timed out and its tables were not transcribed.
Official FY 2024 annual-report project entry indicating named inland-lake scope and planned project duration through December 2028.
